items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: You see, Bill, there was a difference in the type of music that Nick LaRocca played and the type of music that Georgie and Paul Moreau's and rap.

ctx.x: Yes, I know. He sometimes claims that he originated all of the jazz. Oh, I know.

That's ridiculous. I'll tell you who originated jazz. It was Georgia Burns, Leo Rapola, Rag Baby Stevens, and Chink. Yeah, I believe it was Chink, Chink, Chink. And I don't know who was the other two. There were two more in the band. And them's the one who originated jazz. Some of the New Orleans rhythm gigs. New Orleans rhythm. Paul Moreau. Yeah. Paul Moreau. Yeah, Paul Moreau. Yeah, that's right. It was Paul Moreau's, too. Yeah. And them's the boys that originated jazz here. Went up north and did good. When…
